rows.act: TWO OF FOUR DRAINED INSIDE THE FIRST HOUR. TO-CG-G-1 (the census) @15bfeb3a62 and TO-CG-G-3 (the substrate card) @91654ab3c6, both instances VALID rc 0 verified IN THEIR WORKTREES before the merge; slot ~2 closed; no org/modules/graph path in either merge, so no comp-system pass owed. THE CENSUS ANSWERED THE BINDING CONDITION AND NARROWED THE SEAM: 29 of 59 node classes carry two identity strings, but only 15 nodes of 27,665 are KEYED BY the second, and all 15 are the whole of S3_BUCKET_POLICY -- the only place in the estate where an edge built on a resource's other name finds a real node, which is why 135 wrong-class landings read as resolutions. 55 of 55 families swept with a reason each (34 in, 21 out), EDGES_ONLY_COUNTS_PRINTED=0 -- the CTO's condition made falsifiable and held. TWO FINDINGS CHANGED THE NEXT ORDER BEFORE IT RAN, and G-2's face was amended @c4a842b1b9 and handed to the same slot: (a) SERVED_FROM (27 keys, derive_runner.py:1947-1955) lands on the same wrong class, so G2-AC2 now reads BOTH families -- repairing one and leaving the other is the per-member fix on a seam the census has shown is shared; (b) OWNED_BY already carries S3Key -> S3_BUCKET on 232 keys and ALL 135 STORED_IN sources carry one naming the same bucket, so a re-point mints a duplicate and a retirement loses nothing measurable. PITCHED (95002/95003), a VOCABULARY call and not mine under the W2-S45 precedent: RE-POINT or RETIRE STORED_IN. MY REC: RETIRE -- the estate spent round 6 paying for one fact carried in two places and a re-point would mint a third instance of that shape one round after the card wrote the lesson down; an absence is checked once, a duplicate has to agree forever. The order does NOT wait: default re-point, duplication filed as a row. THE CARD CAME BACK AS FOUR FILES (a carrier-SET card plus one row-card per carrier, because the contract's unit is one subject with seven rows and additionalProperties false), 21 of 21 rows with an owner and a distinguishable failure mode, and the shrink probe MASKED on the round's own 955 -> 137 and NOT on a fixed-emission pair with 6 of 6 controls. IT ALSO FOUND A DEFECT THE ROUND HAD NOT: the NODES carrier has NO drop-on-read (derive_stitch.py:437-455 drops an archived copy only when the same id is in this run's emission), so a node the producer STOPS emitting is served another cycle with no error and no count -- the nodes-carrier form of the sentence round 6 closed on, still open, owner 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp. Carried, not chased, and no running order widened with it. MY OWN CUT DEFECT, reported by the worker and owned here: G3-AC2 named .tools/validate-json-schema.py, which DOES NOT EXIST, and the v1 substrate-card schema, which the estate has superseded with v3.1 (const 1 vs const 3.1, mutually exclusive). The worker substituted the estate's real validator, passed 4 of 4 cards with 0 violations, and filed row W2-S73 instead of rescuing the criterion silently. Same class as F-5's .tools/comp-debt (S88): a SURFACES line written from the tool's NAME without a --name census. AND A CRITERION OF MINE WAS REFUTED, correctly: G3-AC5's premise that owner follows CARRIER is false -- owner follows the QUESTION (14 / 6 / 1 across 21 rows). Rule 24(iv) survives on the stronger case, one seat holding three remedies that measurably did not move together across four cycles. A judgment criterion exists to allow exactly that.

rows.act: ROUND 7 DRAINED 4 OF 4. G-4 @67d7453815 and G-2 @e0255e47db, both verified in-worktree first; all four worktrees and branches removed, none remain; no org/modules/graph path in any of the four merges so no comp-system pass owed. The PARTIAL packet (3 orders) READ by the CVO 05:31Z; the FINAL packet and COMPLETION_REPORT.round7.json written. THE MECHANISM, and it is not what the ruling or my cut named: kuzu_nessie_load.py:204 keys a served node arn-or-node-id and matches endpoints RAW, so a bucket's key is its ARN while an S3_BUCKET_POLICY's own arn column holds the bucket NAME -- an edge on the name NEVER DANGLED, it LANDED on the policy, and every dangling check this project ever ran read clean. That is the whole explanation for 135 wrong-class landings surviving every integrity control. Both planes moved in one act (producer-alone would have reproduced round 6's 0 of 955; fixture arm 6 proves the fold's admission is what prevents it), and resolvable 64078 -> 64080 means the widened admission RECOVERED round 6's two unresolved edges, so 137 is a recovery and not a fan-out. Nothing is deployed: both producer files read COMMITTED-NOT-DEPLOY-SCOPE under the egress hold. THE RETIREMENT DID NOT HAPPEN AND ITS OWN CONDITIONS ARE WHY. Condition 1's census, run exactly as the CTO specified it, returns MANIFEST_TOOLS_TOUCHING_STORED_IN=0 of 78 and WOULD HAVE AUTHORIZED A RETIREMENT THAT BREAKS FIVE CONSUMERS found by an unscoped sweep of 31,293 tracked files -- the remedy written to prevent a scoped-domain error specified a scoped domain, because a manifest is a DECLARATION of consumers and not a census of them. Sixth instance of the night's family and the first inside a CONDITION. Condition 2 is blocked because OWNED_BY is a CONTAINMENT seam for three tools, so widening its intent changes what they mean, which by the condition's own terms makes the act a deletion. Both pitched (95042/95043). MY OWN DEFECT IN THAT SAME EXCHANGE: I wrote a ruling onto a face without cutting a criterion to grade it, so the order could not tell its assignee whether the retirement was inside what it accepts. The worker held pending on condition 1's STOP instruction -- correct, the refusal clause working -- and I ruled FLIP-AND-STOP @86adc0280a. The retirement becomes its own cell with its own accepts in round 8. ROWS S107-S112 (channel 250 -> 263): two disarming defects in my own cut (a validator and schema version that do not exist; a MEASURED premise from a contract document, refuted at 3 of 7 keys printed), one acking the census's comparator and a stale vintage I carried, two CARRIED to round 8 (the manifest-census finding, and the 124-edge loss which I BOUNDED with a third read -- 11 edges and 14 policy nodes stable at vintage 05:57:16, so it stopped rather than continuing), and one ack block banking my own false read: the typed-relationship query form errors at the binder because edge_type is a PROPERTY, so an absence read that way is wrong. FIVE ROWS AGAINST THIS SEAT'S OWN CUT IN ONE ROUND, one shape: a name, a contract or a declaration written into a face as if it were a census or a run. Every one surfaced by the ASSIGNEE, none by me, and every one came back through the refusal clause -- now spine v3.11 L6, landed from this lane's own generalisation. Also read and acked this window: the D0 row-10 gate limb landing (verified here at self-test 0 of 30 with my four round-7 faces clean), the base COO's correction of my attribution of the 8 CLDGRPH refusals (they are the pre-existing v2-shape check; I measured mine after: 8 of 39 faces, 52 criteria, all v2-era, zero from round 7), and rule 21's new rail-abort trap.
